obligations.topic: Fact classes and truthful ablation scope
obligations.classification: demonstrated documentation/measurement-contract mismatch; no analyzer counterexample established
obligations.observation: IKOS_BMC_DISABLE_AI_FACTS disables single_execution in addition to offset bounds and no_wrap. single_execution admits immutable helper publication, so this flag now removes supported semantics as well as optional numerical constraints. Existing ablation script requires identical verdicts but labels the toggle numerical-only.
obligations.minimal_contract: Separate execution preconditions/startup and at-most-once lifetime certificates from optional numerical facts. Preserve the former for a same-capability speed ablation; alternatively explicitly call the existing flag all-certificate ablation and permit/report supported-verdict losses. Record consumed single_execution count alongside bounds/no_wrap.
tests: Existing helper publication positive with at-most-once certificate enabled/disabled; expect capability loss to be counted rather than interpreted as speedup
Existing ai-facts/unused-local.c with only numerical facts disabled; same verdict and AR ACCEPT
Compare paths, prefixes, queries, model validation, time/RSS under serial alternating repeats
obligations.go: Every ablation report lists actual fields disabled and separates capability effect from cost effect.
obligations.no_go: Use current flag to claim equivalent full semantic coverage or broad numerical-AI speedup.

obligations.topic: Offset facts have two different semantic consumers
obligations.classification: unproved provenance/coverage obligation; current code shows explicit fallbacks, not a demonstrated defect
obligations.observation: AccessRecord offset intervals are consumed first by an unbounded candidate-deletion rule, then again as conjuncts in a bounded execution query. Their hazards differ: incorrect SAFE filtering can lose a race; extra BMC constraints ordinarily lose witnesses, provided unsupported/UNSAT remains UNKNOWN. CandidateFacts currently carries bare booleans/bounds, no access key, common object, epoch or proof identity.
obligations.minimal_contract: Document or type an AccessBounds fact keyed by access/abstract context and concrete-base interpretation, carrying pointer width, byte width and stable-analysis epoch. Scope covers every dynamic occurrence represented by that AccessRecord. No shared-load interval may become a concrete load equality; actual rf remains mandatory.
tests: Two threads update a shared index so a stale initial index hull would remove overlap
Overlapping widths at unequal starts, unknown width, pointer wrap and signed/unsigned offset variants
Same statement in two thread instances and helper call contexts with different offsets
Disable only optional BMC bounds and require supported successful executions remain AR ACCEPT
obligations.go: A SAFE-deleting consumer has a coverage argument; a BMC bound is a constraint with explicit UNKNOWN fallback, never an RF source.
obligations.no_go: Feed a path-local/stale/shared-value interval into global candidate deletion or use it as a real initialized value.

obligations.topic: No-wrap certificates replace executable definedness obligations
obligations.classification: restricted proof implementation present; all-context/transform stability remains a proof obligation
obligations.observation: Producer conjoins proofs across checked contexts, rejects loads/formals/phi and shared-dependent control, and proves add/sub/mul ranges. Consumer skips prefix arithmetic encoding on true proof, while demanded results still encode exactly. A wrong proof can admit undefined execution, so this field is part of FALSE trusted base, not just a harmless search hint.
obligations.minimal_contract: Bind proof to AR operation/opcode/type/no_wrap and immutable program revision; state valid for every occurrence/context the BMC can select. Record source/control restrictions and epoch of checked contexts. Missing or invalid proof must execute the exact arithmetic/definedness check. Do not extend to shared-origin expressions until stable interference premises exist.
tests: Existing unused-local unsigned-char promotion positive
Signed max + 1 unused result must not be validated as a defined prefix
Same helper invoked from one safe and one overflowing context
Shared guard/load, repeated loop occurrence, changed ABI, phi and redefined formals must invalidate rather than reuse an irrelevant proof
obligations.go: Proof premises match selected operation and all reachable contexts; positive/control/variant and independent AR arithmetic checks pass.
obligations.no_go: Treat the absence of a checked bad context as proof of all dynamic contexts, or cache an AR-pointer proof across program transformation.

obligations.topic: At-most-once function is not object freshness or liveness
obligations.classification: restricted implementation present; extensions require additional distinct premises
obligations.observation: ConcurrentGlobalEnv scans whole bundle for a unique direct call/create chain rooted in implicit main, excluding cycles/address escape. BMC uses it only alongside an actual pre-spawn store to a pointer slot with unique LLVM store; published_pointer refuses multiple actual occurrences. Those separate checks are necessary. Singleton abstract allocation must never stand in for dynamic allocation identity.
obligations.minimal_contract: Keep at-most-once invocation, actual allocation occurrence, slot single writer, publication-before-create, and frame/allocation lifetime as separate predicates. Static certificate cache assumes immutable closed-world bundle and supported entry roots. Export actual dynamic identities for validation.
tests: single-execution/once-helper-join-control.c vs repeated-helper-race.c, loop-helper-race.c, escaped-helper-race.c, main-recursive-race.c
Publication after create vs before create
Two malloc calls of same shape and helper stack escape after return
obligations.go: Every lifetime shortcut combines all required predicates and exact current-program evidence.
obligations.no_go: Use function uniqueness alone as nonescape/freshness, or static call site as globally unique dynamic allocation.

obligations.classification: existing safeguard verified by source; completeness of dependency inventory not proved in this finite audit
obligations.observation: Global iterations flush all partitions and repeat on dirty; thread exit join summaries participate. Final check replay can mutate summaries and adds an UNKNOWN warning if dirty. This avoids treating stale access snapshots as a safety proof. Every future summary affecting values, thread existence/order, aliases or coverage must join this convergence protocol.
obligations.minimal_contract: Inventory each shared summary with lattice order, join/widen, dependencies, dirty trigger and reset lifetime. Export stable epoch/read-only snapshot for final checking; any semantic mutation invalidates the epoch and triggers recomputation or UNKNOWN. MAY and MUST changes both count even when numeric values stay unchanged.
tests: Existing ai-coupled-fixpoint/replay.c and summary.cpp
Change only MUST join summary, protection label or unknown-effect coverage while keeping numeric board unchanged
Discover a new thread or escaping write during final property replay; no SAFE until reconverged
obligations.go: All semantic shared channels have convergence hooks; final checks observe one stable snapshot or produce UNKNOWN.
obligations.no_go: Add cached relation/publication/escape facts outside dirty/equality/reset handling, or silence final replay mutation.

obligations.topic: SAFE filtering and solver feedback need all-execution coverage
obligations.classification: architectural distinction already implemented; global completeness proof not supplied
obligations.observation: Checker filters points-to, width-aware offsets, thread instances/order, actual locks and publication before BMC. Optional pair_exclusion uses independently overapproximating offset/congruence facts over all bytes modulo pointer space; SAT is not a race, UNSAT can remove only the covered pair. Ordinary BMC failure retains warning under demote mode. Effects/thread bodies lacking coverage also emit warning without requiring an access pair.
obligations.minimal_contract: Keep BoundedSearchOutcome distinct from PairExclusionProof. A deletion proof names both covered access sets, object/width/model and stable facts. For future BMC-to-AI refinement, candidate predicates must be independently validated as inductive across initialization, local steps and all interference before impacting SAFE. An unsat core of a bounded trace is only a trace exclusion.
tests: Existing ai-pair-feedback/test_pair_exclusion.cpp and feedback.c
Same static instruction in distinct dynamic threads; join one of multiple instances; recursive shared-reader locks
Width zero, incompatible/empty facts, wrap, budget zero and solver unknown retain candidate
Known racy file whose particular bounded path is UNSAT must remain UNKNOWN, never SAFE
obligations.go: Unbounded overapprox coverage certificate or verified inductive strengthening exists; finite fixtures are validation not proof.
obligations.no_go: Promote bounded UNSAT, reference PASS, missing candidate from uncovered code, or one schedule without a race to global safety.

obligations.topic: Independent AR replay is independent of SMT, not independent of translation
obligations.classification: documented trust boundary; report pipeline source binding is weaker than command-line checker
obligations.observation: Replay independently executes CFG/calls/memory/threads and checks targets using vector clocks and concrete byte values. But program snapshot is exported by analyzer, sharing AR, frontend layout and explicit API contracts. validate_report removes the program from the same result and recomputes its hash; sweep records source hash separately. CLI verifies input_sha256. Thus current AR ACCEPT is not an independent source-to-AR check, and validator is offline, not an analyzer verdict gate.
obligations.minimal_contract: Evidence manifest binds source/YAML/preprocessed bitcode/AR snapshot hashes, compiler options/version, model/API contract and selected execution. Trusted exporter and frontend remain declared TCB until independently checked translation/source witness exists. Count label correctness, AR acceptance and official source validation separately. For every new recovery require all selected models checked, and corruption tests.
tests: scripts/test_bmc_execution.py already mutates program hash, target instance, creator, offset/width, values, rf and synthetic markers
Add distinct source/flags/ABI manifest mismatch negative tests in report-sweep path
If snapshot is modified and rehashed, record that this tests the trusted-input boundary rather than claiming the hash authenticates source semantics
Unhandled op/API and missing evidence classified UNSUPPORTED, not validated
obligations.go: Claims remain conditional AR feasibility; full source proof claims require additional independent translation/source binding.
obligations.no_go: Describe 109 label TPs or AR ACCEPT as all-SAT soundness proof or official witness acceptance.

obligations.topic: One explicit memory/definedness/library contract per analysis result
obligations.classification: supported-subset boundary, no newly demonstrated correctness bug
obligations.observation: Current BMC uses strict SC clocks/latest-write selection and supported pthread/verifier contracts; AR replay has matching explicit library and initialized-byte assumptions. Agreement between two implementations cannot justify an incorrect common model. Reference Dartagnan may accept execution under different initial-memory/printf semantics, as the M3 malloc controls show.
obligations.minimal_contract: Record property/memory model, C-to-LLVM defined-prefix convention, target ABI, allocation failure/initialization, pthread return behavior and supported library side effects. Reference confirmation is a triage condition; transferring a mechanism requires compatible premises. Unknown/unsupported semantics retains UNKNOWN.
tests: M3 heap-initialized-race vs heap-initialized-guard-safe vs calloc-initialized-race across ILP32/LP64
Atomic ordinary-memory distinction and multiple initial writes
Printf synchronization/side effects, malloc uninitialized bytes and noundef value escape
Reference disagreement classified by semantic premise before implementing a general extension
obligations.go: Source/model contracts are explicitly matched and minimum positive/control/variant has the same interpretation in encoder and replay.
obligations.no_go: Create free load values to match reference FAIL or claim SC fragment covers all C11 weak-memory behavior.

increments.title: Bounded creation occurrence selection with surplus children left unscheduled
increments.effort: small semantic increment; a selection record is preferable to repeated implicit first-match assumptions
premises: Actual main prefix executes every retained create and its guards with existing supported ABI/definedness/handle-output contracts.
At least the required number of matching creation occurrences exists; selected occurrences are distinct.
No join/blocking completion in startup; all children may remain unscheduled until startup ends, and unselected children may remain unscheduled for this finite witness.
No startup event is omitted and no child side effect is invented.
increments.approximation: Existential finite-prefix scheduling restriction; only expands selected concrete executions. It proves neither SAFE nor that ignored children are harmless on other executions.

interface.selection: A concrete binding (creator trace identity, creator event index, child entry) per selected worker. CandidateFacts can carry it alongside startup; no new abstract concurrency domain is needed.
interface.address: Use existing BmcEvent/path-local value identity; do not make InternalVariable* an instance identity.
interface.legacy: Preserve the complete legacy first pass over all groups/startups/selections before adding bounded new occurrence alternatives. Fixed-budget discovery preservation is tested, not inferred from local ordering.
interface.argument_scope: First patch admits only already supported argument provenance (reorder pilots pass null). Record creator event index now; later variable arguments must resolve at that creation occurrence, not end-of-startup or unique static definition. No new pointer/integer transport in A.

Extra child remains blocked or contains unsupported code but is genuinely never scheduled in the finite prefix.
Corrupt creator_step in certificate must reject.

No new FP/FN labels, no SAFE verdict from bounded results, all changed counterexamples validated.

increments.title: Handle-slot provenance and bounded joined-child completion
increments.effort: medium-to-large semantic work; split into independent validated commits, not one engine rewrite

target_family.main_worker_obligation: Target main final read versus unjoined worker write. Keep one main frame/continuation; auxiliary completed traces bind distinct creator steps. Worker/worker startup extension does not implement this.

increments.source_evidence: Four creates into array; safe joins all; race controls omit one/odd slots or overwrite slot0 with fifth creation. Every child writes data under its mutex, so auxiliary completion is effectful.

substeps.name: B1 exact typed slot origins
substeps.scope: Static/global or current main-frame pthread_t arrays; exact byte offset, width, bounds and write generation. Exclude escaped/unknown byte writes and heap initially.
substeps.interface: StorageSlot(object identity, byte offset, width) plus origin creation occurrence/generation. Decoder/ABI facts may be shared; abstract origin set and concrete origin instance are separate representations.
substeps.AI: MAY origin sets join by union; strong updates require unique live object and exact slot. A singleton static create site in a loop still represents multiple dynamic instances. No new MUST completed fact solely from an origin singleton.
substeps.BMC: Read handle identifies actual latest create write to exact slot, including overwrite; token is opaque and cannot supply arbitrary source integer comparison semantics.

substeps.name: B2 universal bounded-array completion certificate for AI
substeps.scope: Single unique main invocation; fixed-size array, one affine create loop and one complete corresponding join loop, exact range, no skipped/duplicated/overwritten/detached/escaped handles and no earlier unknown side effects. API success and supported execution preconditions must be explicit.
substeps.result: A proof covering every dynamic child represented by the repeated site permits completed-site MUST after loop; budget-limited iteration alone never establishes it. Universal quantification is over executions reaching the post-join access, not a proof that every child terminates on every execution.
substeps.failures: Off-by-one, stride2, overwritten slot, conditional join, aliased clobber, second parent invocation all invalidate certificate and retain UNKNOWN.
substeps.purpose: Directly addresses the one credible remaining TN join-array task; no automatic claim for13 heap-region tasks.

substeps.name: B3 complete auxiliary BMC traces
substeps.scope: At most4 selected joined auxiliary children with acyclic/no-nested-create return paths and existing scalar-global/mutex effects. Exclude heap allocations/free, TLS and nested joins initially.
substeps.result: Include actual child events, values, SC read-from and mutex order; return precedes matched join, selected unjoined worker remains separately bound.
substeps.engineering: Generalize internal iteration over retained trace views only where required for clocks/value caches/rf/certificate export. Keep two target IDs a/b and existing public query interface; auxiliary trace vectors need not imply an arbitrary concurrency framework.
substeps.soundness: A chosen sequential schedule for auxiliaries may restrict search, but never reinterpret auxiliary execution as parent program-order or omit release/acquire/HB effects. Every joined prefix must really reach return.

owners: core/domain/concurrent_global_env.hpp and lockset_domain.hpp MAY origins/MUST completion when new coordinate required
bmc/unroll.hpp handle source and actual return paths
bmc/evidence.hpp retained auxiliary traces and chosen object/source IDs
scripts/validate_bmc_execution.py actual schedule/handle matching and independent vector-clock validation
increments.budgets: Prototype auxiliary count<=4, bounded completed paths per child and existing shared10s query deadline. Excess is UNKNOWN. AI fixed-loop certificate search has finite syntax budget; failure falls back conservatively.
controls: All original four joined => safe certificate only after full coverage proof.
Join0..2 leaves fourth; join even slots leaves odd; overwrite slot0 leaves original first unjoined.
Joining wrong/newest instance must not complete older instance.
Child needs mutex held across join => no invented terminating prefix.
Auxiliary write changes selected guard/read value; excluding it must be caught by AR replay.
Child loops forever or performs unsupported call => no synthetic completion.
Copied/partial-width/byte-clobbered handle sources reject until modeled.
ILP32/LP64 pthread_t ABI and renamed/extracted helper variants.
exit: B1 validated before B2/B3; B2/B3 separate commits and A/B because AI SAFE and BMC FALSE differ.
The four-way family produces either corresponding validated result or a concrete next blocker; do not promise all4 automatically.
Stop B3 before nested dependency graphs, symbolic heap handles or arbitrary pthread runtime semantics; these are separate followups.

share: Verified exact API recognition/signature/data layout, source-object byte extents and constant slot extraction.
Statement identities, call provenance and concrete trace serialization primitives.
AI may-bounds/points-to/freshness provenance with explicit scope and fallback, supplied as candidate facts rather than concrete values.
do_not_share_as_same_fact: AI static site can denote arbitrarily many dynamic children; BMC creator occurrence denotes one exact child.
AI absence/SAFE requires complete coverage of all represented instances and interference; BMC may choose a feasible subset schedule but must keep its dependencies.
AI join(MUST) is intersection, origin/liveness(MAY) union; BMC joins an exact completed instance.
BMC UNSAT on one bounded prefix cannot discharge an AI candidate or universal ownership proof.
shared_infrastructure.practical_boundary: Do not move Z3 expressions or concrete event clocks into core abstract domains. Keep shared facts free of solver/runtime interpretation; semantic consumers own proof direction.
shared_infrastructure.heap_TN_relation: Remaining15 =13 region/publication +1 array-to-heap field coverage +1 dynamic join-array. Slot/identity work addresses only last directly. For list2, read-only pre-spawn heap next-field provenance is a distinct narrow first AI increment; dynamic region ownership follows only after field/interference/lifetime envelope, not from BMC examples.

minimal_boundary: Only both selected roots are workers activated by implicit main. Keep current main-vs-worker behavior separate until its spawn/HB/source logic also consumes an explicit create occurrence.

Preserve every startup instruction, including creates for unselected children, guards, memory writes, library outputs, called helper prefixes and arithmetic definedness. Choose successful default-attribute creates with valid output slots under existing API contract.

Use one startup descriptor with two indices into the executed event sequence (or equivalent occurrence identities). Each index must designate a supported Create of the corresponding entry. Same entry requires distinct indices. Carry the same descriptor to argument resolution, pointer/address preparation, activation proof and evidence export; do not rediscover occurrences by function name.

Start with current supported actual argument subset (constant global address/unique external chain/main object identity). Resolving an argument uses the definition context at its chosen create, not at prefix end. Repeated helper/loop definitions and symbolic indices can remain unsupported until an occurrence-scoped resolver exists.

All children, selected and unselected, remain unscheduled during the main startup. Main suspends after startup; its frame and referenced allocations must still live. Scheduling only selected workers afterward is an existential finite prefix and does not require fairness or completion of extras.

Retain conditional-startup no-Join/no-Unsupported and held.empty requirements, with valid matching nonrecursive locks and closed verifier atomics. Existing encoder refuses startup cond_wait; do not relax it. A startup waiting for a child cannot use the dormant-child proof.

Extra children execute no body events. Any join in selected prefixes still requires an actual supported completion; existing inert-return exception is narrow. Do not silently ignore extra child side effects needed to satisfy a guard, join, signal, semaphore or barrier.
All create handle writes remain part of library-storage/alias accounting. Keep unknown/overlapping handle representation restrictions; do not delete extras to simplify the create count or ids.

Enumerate old first/second selection before alternatives and keep old search pass ahead of newly expanded work; preserving logical satisfiability does not by itself preserve a previous success under fixed global deadlines.

Current startup unroll targets only occurrences1/2 of each create statement and caps8 prefixes. Keep or explicitly increase finite search policy; merely allowing >= does not reach third loop occurrence when no later target is unrolled.

fact_class_formal_contract.formula: If every SAT model of base E denotes a valid race, then every SAT model of E AND F does too, even if F is too narrow. To preserve witness coverage require E implies F (or at least every required witness has an equivalent F model).
fact_class_formal_contract.effect: Invalid overly narrow F loses confirmations; with failed BMC->UNKNOWN it does not establish SAFE. The same F used by a SAFE candidate-deletion rule requires sound all-execution overapproximation and can cause FN if wrong.

fact_class_formal_contract.formula: If exact encoding is E0 AND D and certificate removes D, require E0 AND certificate-premises implies D for every selected occurrence.
fact_class_formal_contract.effect: A wrong certificate expands admissible executions and can produce spurious FALSE, even for otherwise-unused arithmetic. Demanded result exactness alone does not protect an elided unused definedness obligation.

fact_class_formal_contract.formula: Certificate must imply the object/instance/definition identity and lifetime assumptions used to interpret the selected events; actual startup execution remains separately required.
fact_class_formal_contract.effect: A wrong certificate can interpret accesses or values using the wrong allocation/publication and create false execution. Missing certificate may reject a capability, unlike an optional redundant solver bound.

fact_class_formal_contract.formula: Ordering only, with no event/constraint removal, preserves unbounded logical query set; fixed-budget observed coverage is still order-dependent.
fact_class_formal_contract.effect: Benchmark improvements are precision under resource bounds; do not confuse with a stronger semantic theorem.

All partitions publish interference including exits without unlock. Shared boards and dependent facts participate in dirty/fixpoint protocol; final checks use stable summaries.
Finite bins, fixed policy during each analysis and existing per-bin widening give a termination argument. One finite retry prevents endless adaptive refinement.
No value/lock correlation is inferred from Data-only partitioning; consumer initially targets unreachable local guard -> removed access only.
Unknown calls, missing object/lifetime coverage and unmatched threads keep UNKNOWN regardless of apparently precise local states.

synthetic_diagnostic.exact_states: At merge (b,x,y) are (0,0,0), (1,1,2), (2,2,1). Guard x==1 && y==1 is infeasible, but separate intervals x,y in[0,2] and a convex hull permit(1,1); scalar congruences are both TOP. Three b partitions keep constants and eliminate guard.
synthetic_diagnostic.positive_expected: After proving current unpartitioned IR actually warns, requested partitioned AI should eliminate unreachable worker write and return SAFE. No claim this verdict change already happened.
synthetic_diagnostic.racy_control: Change b==2 branch from x=2,y=1 to x=1,y=1; now worker write is reachable and may race with main write. Refinement must retain may/race and must not return SAFE.
wrong_feedback_cases: Omit b==2 from suggested bins: consumer must add complement/merge or reject; racy control stays reachable.
Suggest unrelated local q: may only lose efficiency/precision, never drop states or fabricate SAFE.
Change source or reuse a stale statement/SSA ID: reject hint.
Use selector loaded from shared state or escaped memory: reject in first scope; do not freeze sampled value against interference.
Budget zero or interval grows outside enumerated values: disable/merge and keep complete coverage.
synthetic_diagnostic.variants: Renamed variables, reordered branches, constants widened to u64, extracted pure helper if already modeled, and repeated same worker instances; no filename-based policy.

comparison_to_portfolio: Control1: same base AI and BMC, feedback off.
Control2: unconditional interval-congruence / DBM / existing relational domain using same IR and resource limit; if it matches gain more cheaply there is no case for new feedback.
Control3: unconditional local partitioning and syntax/dependency-only selector heuristic without BMC; this isolates value of solver guidance from generic path sensitivity.
Control4: BMC query run but hint discarded, to charge query cost and isolate consumer effect.

Guided mechanism must demonstrate fewer selected regions/cost at equal precision or new precision not explained by stronger-domain portfolio; artificial seed alone cannot establish research contribution.
exit_gates: No-go now for claiming actual feedback benefit on15: prerequisite semantic gaps dominate and no measured merge-loss cause exists.
After semantic work, inspect same tasks and, if necessary, remaining safe-label UNKNOWNs once for explicit merge-loss candidates; do not launch broad new feedback algorithm before one is admitted.

Proceed with exactly one pilot only after actual loss is captured. Require positive/racy/wrong-feedback controls, complete fixed-point checks, mechanism ablations, at least one real task and separate held-out related tasks before any general benefit claim.

If benefit only appears in synthetic seed, or unconditional domain/partition heuristic dominates, record negative research result and stop this pilot; keep AI->BMC work as current supported direction.
